digest.component_or_area: code-review impact scoring and pass-2 severity assessment
propositions: Code-v3 impact model discards verifier's prod_impact and trigger_likelihood fields for maint-lane findings, preventing test-sufficiency findings from reaching blocking threshold despite identifying load-bearing paths.

Commit 8eadb4fbc5 shipped a contract declaring stale>0 as allowed (exit 0) with a co-shipped test asserting stale=0, a contradiction that code-review missed because no antipattern flags test assertions contradicting contract declarations.

Code-v4 must introduce a forbids_contract_allowed_state binary in CodeSeverityAttrs that flags when a test forbids a state the same diff's contract declares allowed, guarded against flagging deliberate stated tightening.

Code-v4 impact_code must re-scope prod_impact for coverage/contract findings to mean user-facing reach of the guarded path (replacing test-only=>none clause), consuming this field via lane-scoped trigger maps (prod unchanged; moderate-maint {rare 0.75, else 1.0}; debt churn-amplifier-only).
Tests lane must flip from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.54 in criteria_routing.json, yielding v4 replay block-set of 99 changes (8.0%) vs v3's 42 (3.4%), with zero demotions and no new validity floor.

Reversibility floor must restrict to consequence lanes (floor 0.6 requires consequence base>0 AND hard_to_reverse_surface); debt-only findings never floor, keeping 4 existing debt+hard_to_reverse findings advisory and replay identical.
